description: Get NRW telemetry readings for a measure_id over at most 7 days. Preserves source timestamps, values and quality codes; timestamps lack an explicit timezone (OGL v3). Returns source data and provenance; supported hydrological units are normalised to SI. TerraMCP is a Wrench AI service. Open data: no API key or signup required. Anonymous limits: 60 calls/hour and 300/day per IP and session; keys offer higher limits, with anonymous fallback after monthly quota. Source licence warnings apply.

end.description: End ISO 8601 timestamp with timezone offset; start/end must be ordered and at most 7 days apart.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return; bounded by this tool's schema.

measure_id.description: NRW measure identifier returned by nrw_measures.

start.description: Start ISO 8601 timestamp with timezone offset; start/end must be ordered and at most 7 days apart.

name: nrw_readings
